profile.name: Alazar.A
profile.title: Full-Stack Developer & MERN Engineer
profile.shortBio: Dedicated Full-Stack Software Engineer specializing in modern MERN architecture, distributed cloud backends, and responsive React web experiences. Passionate about writing scalable TypeScript, high-throughput APIs, and intuitive user interfaces.
profile.fullBio: With over 4 years of engineering experience across high-growth startups and modern web solutions, I build end-to-end applications from MongoDB data modeling to interactive React client applications. I focus on clean code architecture, performance optimization, and robust developer tooling.

projects.title: Mernify - Cloud E-Commerce & Analytics Platform
projects.description: Enterprise multi-tenant retail analytics and e-commerce portal built with MongoDB Atlas, Express, React, and Node.js. Features real-time order tracking, payment processing, and dashboard telemetry.
projects.longDescription: Mernify is a comprehensive full-stack commerce engine built to support high-concurrency order processing and deep catalog analytics. Engineered with MongoDB aggregation pipelines for instant sales reporting, dynamic stock monitoring, and secure role-based access control.

projects.title: DevFlow - Collaborative Sprint Workspace
projects.description: Kanban sprint tracking and asynchronous team communication platform for software squads with real-time websocket task synchronization and burndown charts.
projects.longDescription: Designed to reduce project bottlenecks, DevFlow integrates sprint planning, pull request linking, and team workload balancing into a single streamlined workspace. Backed by MongoDB for flexible schema updates and lightning-fast nested task queries.

projects.title: PulseAPI - Microservices Gateway & Rate Limiter
projects.description: High-throughput reverse proxy and API token metering gateway built on Node.js and MongoDB cache indexes with token bucket traffic throttling.
projects.longDescription: PulseAPI handles distributed authentication, route routing, and usage quotas across 14 decoupled microservices. Built with extensive error telemetry, automated health probes, and structured JSON logging.
